clarification_summary: Prior direct manufacturing cost values were preliminary manufacturing-cost worksheet values and should not be treated as accepted formal quote prices. The current production pricing represents a budgetary production estimate suitable for feasibility discussion, not a binding formal production quote.
notes: Direct manufacturing cost ($432/$1,029/$2,058) is not customer quote price.
Current budgetary production estimate pricing: $875/$2,100/$4,150 for 100/250/500 units.
Pricing is based on shop-supplied wood and Velcro materials.
Labor, finishing, and packaging are excluded pending customer requirements.
This classification supersedes any prior interpretation of the referenced documents as formal quotes.
